_comment: All texts of the game (English). PLACEHOLDER lines, to be rewritten. Tokens: {name:id} = display name from names.json, {text:key} = another text, {n} etc. = values from the code.
title.subtitle: prototype
board.notice.default: Lovely day on {name:place_world}! {n} adventurers expected. Smile!
board.notice.sunny: Sunny with a chance of adventurers ({n})! Hydrate and smile!
world.bell_evening: *ding* End of shift. Time to go home.
world.incident_respawn:
*ding*
{name:protagonist} is back at the Pool. It's an hour later. Whatever was inside is gone.
world.heroes_coming: Footsteps. Someone is whistling a victory tune.
dlg.mentor.greet_1: Morning. I'm {name:mentor}. I've told you that three hundred and forty times, but it's fine.
dlg.mentor.greet_2: Morning. You don't know me. I know you. Nine hundred days. You start noticing things.
dlg.mentor.tasks: Pot on the path, chest under the old tree, grass in the field. Shards, coins, seeds. You carry them inside. One at a time.
dlg.mentor.tip_1: Pots go back on the pedestal. Shards point up. Don't ask me why.
dlg.mentor.colleagues: Gig's on the path again. Gig is always on the path again.
dlg.mentor.idle_1: Heroes take the path at nine and at two. Be somewhere else.
dlg.mentor.idle_2: Somebody left a job half done. Somebody always does.
dlg.mentor.question_2: Have you ever wondered why the pots always break right where we work?
dlg.colleague.idle: Lowkey love this spot. Great view of the path, no cap.
dlg.colleague.warn_narration: {name:protagonist} wobbles toward the path, then back, then toward the Pool.
dlg.colleague.warn_reply: Oh. Oh! Heroes? You ate. I'm going to go stand somewhere else. Like a professional.
dlg.home.kid_plays: {name:kid} is in the corner with a wooden sword, defeating a rag slime.
dlg.kid.play: Hyah! Take that, slime! Level up!
end.title: End of the prototype
end.body:
{name:mentor} asked a question. {name:protagonist} will not remember it. You will.

Days: {days}   Bells you might have counted: {bells}
battle.log.pose: {hero} strikes a pose. For whom, unclear.
battle.log.focus: {hero} closes her eyes and gathers mana.
battle.log.falls_asleep: {hero} breathes the spores and falls asleep.
battle.log.absorb_mud: The Slime absorbs some mud. It feels heavy.
battle.log.absorb_spores: The Slime absorbs a blue mushroom. Spores everywhere.
battle.log.absorb_nothing: The Slime looks for something to absorb.
battle.log.hide_nowhere: The Slime has nowhere to hide.
battle.log.too_heavy: The Slime is too heavy to run.
battle.log.heroes_leave: The party moves on. No EXP here.
battle.bored.3: {name:hero_sword}: Nothing personal. I've got a quota.
world.day_end: It's dark. {name:protagonist} finds the way home anyway.
world.walk_home_hint: Home is past the sign, bottom left.
board.notice.day1:
A lovely day ahead.
{n} adventurers expected.
Keep smiling!
board.notice.day2:
{n} adventurers expected.
Today's incident forecast: perfectly manageable.
Every little slime makes a difference!
board.notice.day3:
Only {n} adventurers expected!
Efficiency is everyone's responsibility.
Together, we make tomorrow possible.
board.footer: Thank you for keeping the Meadow wonderful!
world.pot_broken_found: The pot is in pieces again. Same pieces, same places.
dlg.mentor.greet_1b: Morning. {name:mentor}. Goblin. Your boss, sort of. Don't worry about it.
dlg.mentor.tasks_short: Pot, chest, grass. Same as always.
dlg.mentor.leftover: Somebody left a job half done. Somebody always does. Finish it if you like. Nobody will notice. I will.
dlg.mentor.idle_1a: Heroes take the path around nine and around two. Be somewhere else.
dlg.mentor.idle_1b: Don't rush. The grass will still be here tomorrow.
dlg.mentor.idle_1c: Someone has to put things back.
dlg.mentor.idle_1d: The board? Nobody writes it. It just knows things.
dlg.mentor.idle_2a: Funny how they always arrive just after we've finished repairing everything.
dlg.mentor.idle_2b: Count the bells sometime. Just for fun.
dlg.mentor.question_a: Do you think they know who fixes all this?
dlg.mentor.question_b: How many times can something happen before it stops being an accident?
dlg.mentor.question_3: Don't answer. You'll forget it anyway. I won't.
dlg.colleague.idle_1: Hey bestie. Lowkey love this spot. Best view of the path, no cap.
dlg.colleague.idle_2: I had a whole thing planned today. Can't remember what. Vibes were good though.
dlg.colleague.idle_3: Do you ever feel like you've been here before? Same. Weird.
dlg.colleague.at_pool: Took a break by the Pool. The bell rang anyway. Somebody else's turn, I guess.
dlg.colleague.after_incident: Woke up at the Pool. Was I doing something? Feels like I was doing something.
dlg.kid.play_1: Hyah! Take that, slime! I am Brand! Nothing personal!
dlg.kid.play_2: Hyah! I got all the hero cards except Temp. Nobody wants Temp.
dlg.kid.play_3: Hyah! When I'm a hero I'll come by the Meadow. I'll be careful with the pots.
bark.sword.1: Nothing personal. I've got a quota.
bark.sword.2: Two more slimes and I can call it a morning.
bark.sword.3: Same field as yesterday. Good field.
bark.mage.1: Four spells left. Let's make them count.
bark.mage.2: If this one has no EXP I'm billing someone.
bark.mage.3: Do they ever... do anything? The slimes?
bark.thief.1: If it's shiny, it's probably worth something.
task.done_line.pot: It will be broken again by Thursday. That is the job.
task.done_line.chest: Next week a Hero will open it and call it loot.
task.done_line.grass: Nobody will notice the grass grew back. That means it went well.
task.done_line.leftover_pot: Your colleague's pot. They will say thanks. Probably.
task.done_line.leftover_chest: The chest is whole. The paperwork is still half.
peek.equip:
EQUIP
Bronze Sword +2
Round Shield
Boots (still wet)
order.pot:
WORK ORDER, the Path:
the pot got broken by visitors.
Please put it back together before they pass again ({time})!
order.chest:
WORK ORDER, the Old Tree:
the chest is looking a little empty.
Please restock it with the coins lying around, so visitors have something to find!
order.grass:
WORK ORDER, the Field:
the grass got trampled.
Please plant seeds from the sack so it's green for the next visitors!
order.leftover_pot:
WORK ORDER, the Old Tree:
a colleague started gluing a pot and couldn't finish.
Please finish it!
order.leftover_chest:
WORK ORDER, the Field:
a colleague left a chest half full.
Please finish it!
board.job.pot: - Pot on the Path: {p}/{a} pieces back
board.job.chest: - Chest by the Old Tree: {p}/{a} coins in
board.job_done.chest: - Chest by the Old Tree: done!
board.job.grass: - Grass in the Field: {p}/{a} patches planted
board.note.default: A note, by hand: "Please leave the path clear." ({name:mentor})
board.note.pot_1: A note, by hand: "The pot near the path needs attention again." ({name:mentor})
board.note.pot_2: A note, by hand: "Wasn't that already repaired?" Someone underlined "already". ({name:mentor})
board.note.pot_3: A note, by hand: "Same pot. Same pieces. Same places." The ink is older than the paper. ({name:mentor})
dlg.mentor.react_gig_hurt: Gig is at the Pool. He doesn't remember. That's the kind part, I suppose.
dlg.mentor.react_gig_warned: Gig told me you warned him. He said it like it was his idea. Let him.
dlg.mentor.react_pot_1: You know, I used to think that pot was particularly fragile.
dlg.mentor.react_pot_2: Funny thing. The pot was here before the path.
dlg.mentor.react_pot_3: I wonder who decided this was where it belonged.
